questions.question: How far in advance should I book my move?
questions.answer: We recommend booking at least 2-4 weeks in advance, especially during peak moving seasons (summer months). However, we can often accommodate last-minute moves based on availability.

questions.question: Do you provide packing materials?
questions.answer: Yes, we offer a full range of packing materials including boxes, bubble wrap, packing paper, and tape. We also provide professional packing services if you prefer to have our team handle the packing.

questions.question: Are my belongings insured during the move?
questions.answer: Yes, we provide basic coverage for all moves. We also offer additional insurance options for valuable items. Our team will discuss coverage options with you during the estimate.

questions.question: What areas do you service?
questions.answer: We provide moving services throughout the metropolitan area and offer long-distance moving services across the state and nationwide. Contact us to confirm service availability in your area.

questions.question: How do you calculate moving costs?
questions.answer: Moving costs are based on factors including distance, size of the move, services required, and time of year. We provide free, detailed estimates with no hidden fees.
